name: brokerage_order_cancel
title: Request that a working order be canceled
description: Asks the venue to cancel a working order and reports what actually happened to it. Use when the customer asks to cancel, call off, pull or stop an order that has not filled. Do not use to change an order's price or size, which is brokerage_order_replace and keeps the order alive, and do not use it to undo a filled order, which is not possible — reversing a fill means trading in the opposite direction at whatever the market then is. This tool needs no confirmation token, because cancelling reduces exposure rather than creating it and a customer in a hurry should not have to wait for a priced preview. It still requires the customer's explicit approval before it runs. Read cancelled and status together rather than assuming success. An order can fill in the moment between the customer asking and the venue hearing, and in that case cancelled is false, status is FILLED, and the customer now owns the shares; say so plainly instead of reporting a cancellation that did not happen. On a partially filled order the shares that already filled remain and only the unfilled remainder is canceled. Repeating this call on an already canceled order is harmless and reports the same final state.

accountId.description: The account holding the order, from brokerage_accounts_list.

orderId.description: The order to cancel, from brokerage_orders_list. Never guess one.

cancelled.description: Whether the cancellation took effect. False is common and not an error; read status and explanation and tell the customer.

symbol.description: The instrument the order was for.

filledQuantity.description: Shares that filled before the cancellation. These remain; only the rest was canceled.

status.description: The order's real state now. FILLED means it beat the cancellation and the customer owns the shares.

explanation.description: What happened, in words that can be read to the customer. Always present.

updatedAt.description: When the order last changed, in UTC.

approval.confirmationTemplate:
Cancel this order?

  Order {{orderId}}: {{side}} {{quantity}} {{symbol}} in {{accountNickname}}
  {{orderTypeDescription}}, {{filledQuantity}} of {{quantity}} filled so far

The order may still fill before the cancellation reaches the market.
